dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: I've got to do my best in training... Huh? I don't think I've seen you before. Who are you? Ah, wait, no, let me guess.

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: You're tall, and you look completely different from us Melusines... I know. You must be from outside the village!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A deduction most brilliant...

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: I—I mean, I'm just a trainee... That's why my skills are still lacking.

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: But I've been training diligently every day. One day soon, I'll be able to officially join the Marechaussee Phantom!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do you need to do special training?

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Well, to join the Marechaussee Phantom, of course. Monsieur Neuvillette says that we all have the potential to become Marechaussee agents...

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: But you have to undergo strict assessments to become a member for real, so I have to work hard!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why do you want to join the Marechaussee Phantom?

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Because I want to defend justice as one of their members — and also, their official uniform is super cool.

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Oh yes — my favorite character in "Great Detective Hurlock" is Agent Gina of the Marechaussee Phantom.

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Although her deductions are often full of holes, the effort she puts in to catch criminals for the sake of her future is very inspiring indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: So yes, I dream of becoming a member of the Marechaussee Phantom!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can do it!

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Yup, I'll do my best!

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: It seems I'll need to try harder... Ah yes, thanks for your help previously!

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Hehehe, I was able to help everyone out, and Sedile even praised me — is this my special training paying off?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me what happened to the Eremites from earlier?

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Oh, sure. Sedile contacted the Gardes. They should be in the Maison Gardiennage's custody by now.

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Sedile said that the Marechaussee Phantom is in charge of finding the bad guys — and in the cases that they've been found, we can just directly hand them over to the Maison!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Keep up the good work.

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Yup, I'll do my best!
